fusions.name: Carved Sigil
fusions.desc: Carves a glyph into a target already carrying one of your afflictions, using it up to deal 9 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Twin Glyph-Seeds
fusions.desc: After a 1-second recitation, looses 2 rune-cut seeds at once, spread apart, each dealing 26 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Runic Backlash
fusions.desc: Runes open across your trunk: for 8 seconds, 30% of the elemental damage you take is sent back at whoever cast it.

fusions.name: Annual Recitation
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. You regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
